key_insight: PDSA ranks with a vet-written Staffordshire Bull Terrier breed page that covers health risks, care, a monthly and lifetime cost of ownership and where to get one, but it sells no puppy, prices no puppy, carries no schema and names no city. BSUK can match its vet-style health and cost-of-ownership coverage on a Staffy page and win the buying intent PDSA leaves open: a named breeder's own health-tested litters, a stated price and a direct way to enquire.
